final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS trn ON CAST(ab.translink AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(trn.transreg AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS tr ON CAST(trn.trdref AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(tr.tradereg AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY tr.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.tradekind, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.tradekind, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.cnt - s4.avgcnt AS diff FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s4.avgcnt IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.cnt > s4.avgcnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_difference FROM step5
